name: Halepuna Waikiki by Halekulani
positioning: Sister hotel to the Halekulani in the heart of Waikiki, with interiors by Champalimaud Design and no resort fee
best_for: Travelers who want a Waikiki base two minutes from the beach
Guests who want SpaHalekulani treatments and an infinity pool with Pacific Ocean views

facts.text: Halepuna Waikiki is in the heart of Waikiki on the island of Oahu.
The hotel is just two minutes from the beach.
Halepuna Waikiki is a sister hotel to the Halekulani.
The interiors are by Champalimaud Design.
Guest rooms and suites are furnished in color palettes of white, gray, beige and blue.
Room decor is by local artists.
Complimentary amenities are included with every stay, with no resort fee.
Halepuna guests can choose from a selection of exclusive SpaHalekulani spa and salon treatments.
The fitness studio has high-tech ARTIS equipment by Technogym.
Halepuna guests have signing privileges at Halekulani.
Chef Vikram Garg's Umi celebrates the Ocean's Harvest with seasonal ingredients and cultural infusions.

highlights.text: The Grand Ocean Suite is a one-bedroom suite on the highest floor with unobstructed views of the Pacific Ocean.
The Vitality Pool, on the eighth-floor Urban Escape, has an infinity pool design; the Sun Deck has a custom hot tub and private cabanas, all with views of the Pacific Ocean.
Guests get complimentary admission to the Bishop Museum, the Honolulu Museum of Art and the Manoa Heritage Center by showing their room key.
Surf Halekulani's team offers surf and stand-up paddle experiences for novices and enthusiasts.
A weekly Manager's Wine Reception offers complimentary wine and light bites hosted by the General Manager and management team.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler's reviewer found the entry-level room on the smaller side.
Conde Nast Traveler notes the hotel blends in with many of the larger Waikiki hotels in the area.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy tourist area with high foot traffic.
